description:
Alarm clock for alternating weeks, timetables and rules like every 1st Tuesday

An alarm clock that follows your rhythm – even when it changes from week to week.

Alternating A/B weeks at school, early and late shifts, a uni timetable that differs every other week: with Wake Me you set each alarm once with a flexible rule and it simply goes off on the right days. No more switching alarms on and off every Sunday evening.

Rules the built-in clock app can't do

  • Every n weeks on chosen weekdays – e.g. every other week on Monday and Thursday; the start date decides which week counts
  • Monthly on a weekday – e.g. the 1st Tuesday, the 1st and 3rd Thursday or the last Friday of the month
  • Monthly on a day – e.g. on the 15th or on the last day of the month
  • Every n days, yearly or once – each with a start date and an optional end date

A preview shows the next occurrences, so you can see at a glance whether the rule is right.

Pause instead of deleting
Going on holiday? Pause repeating alarms for days, weeks or months, for a number of occurrences or up to a date. The app lists which occurrences are skipped and resumes by itself afterwards.

Waking up

  • Turn the phone face down to snooze
  • Snooze length and gradually increasing volume per alarm or as a default
  • Device alarm sounds, ringtones or your own audio file
  • Rings reliably in Doze, battery saver and Do Not Disturb, and after a restart even before the first unlock
  • Checks permissions, alarm volume and Do Not Disturb and warns you about anything that would stop the alarm
  • “Missed alarm” notice if the device was off or the alarm stopped without a response
  • Test alarm in 1 minute

Privacy
No internet permission, no ads, no tracking. Your alarms stay on your device.

Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch; the app follows the system language.
